sources.name: Flippa
sources.description: Largest general marketplace. All price points. Auction-style. Less vetting = more noise.

listings.title: B2B Review Management SaaS (MyFrank-style)
listings.description: B2B SaaS platform helping businesses collect and manage Google reviews. QR code attribution to employees, challenges, rewards, and multi-location tracking. Designed for hospitality, retail, franchises.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - review management is crowded but execution matters
analysis.reasoning: Review management for SMBs is proven. QR attribution and gamification is a nice angle. B2B SaaS at $40K MRR is the sweet spot for acquisition - big enough to matter, small enough to afford. Would need to verify churn and CAC.
analysis.opportunity: Expand to other review platforms (Yelp, Trustpilot). Upsell analytics. Roll up similar tools.

listings.title: Web Scraping SaaS on Apify
listings.description: High-margin SaaS built on Apify providing scalable web scraping tools. Fully automated with ~5h/month management required. 10% month-over-month growth.

analysis.uspCopyable: High - Apify ecosystem makes this replicable
analysis.reasoning: This is the dream: $12K/month with 5 hours of work. Growth is strong at 10% MoM. Built on Apify = platform risk but also leverage. Web scraping is evergreen need. The question is defensibility - can someone clone this easily?
analysis.opportunity: Scale on Apify marketplace. Add more scrapers. Bundle into data products.

listings.title: ERP Manufacturing B2B SaaS
listings.description: Profitable ERP solution for manufacturing sector. Over 60% net profit margins. Strong customer retention in a sticky vertical.

analysis.uspCopyable: Very Low - ERP takes years to build and vertical expertise
analysis.reasoning: ERP for manufacturing is as sticky as it gets. 60% net margins are exceptional. $100K MRR is substantial. This is a cash cow acquisition - buy it, maintain it, collect checks. Don't try to copy this.
analysis.opportunity: Hold for cash flow. Potentially sell to PE roll-up in manufacturing software space.

listings.title: Art & Digital Media SaaS
listings.description: SaaS business in the art and digital media niche. Created August 2012. Consistent profitability with strong margins.

analysis.uspCopyable: Low - 12 years of brand building
analysis.reasoning: 12 years of operation is rare. Proves the business model works. Creative tools niche is growing. The 59x multiple is high but reflects the stability. Need to verify if it's growing or declining.
analysis.opportunity: Stable cash flow. Could modernize with AI features. Established brand in niche market.

listings.title: Amazon FBA Home Products Business
listings.description: Amazon FBA business in home products niche. Operating since 2009. Strong brand presence and consistent profitability.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - FBA model is replicable, brand is not
analysis.reasoning: $62K monthly profit is substantial. 15 years on Amazon shows adaptability. But 100% Amazon dependency is risky - one policy change or suspension can kill you. The multiple reflects this risk.
analysis.opportunity: Diversify to D2C, Walmart, other channels. The brand equity could transfer off-platform.

listings.title: Content Site - Relationships Niche
listings.description: Content website in the relationships and communication niche. Started in 2023. Growing traffic and affiliate revenue.

analysis.uspCopyable: High - content sites are commodity now
analysis.reasoning: Content sites are risky post-ChatGPT. Google updates have decimated many. The fact it started in 2023 and survived is interesting - may have adapted to new reality. Relationships niche has emotional content that AI struggles with.
analysis.opportunity: If traffic is from diverse sources (social, email, direct), less risky. Could pivot to community or courses.

listings.title: Dreamer Designs - E-commerce Brand
listings.description: Established e-commerce brand sold for $2M. Cross-border acquisition from Canada to US buyer. Completed in 69 days.

analysis.uspCopyable: N/A - this is a closed deal
analysis.reasoning: Included as a benchmark. $2M e-commerce exit in 69 days shows the market is active. Cross-border deals are happening. This is what a successful e-commerce exit looks like.
analysis.opportunity: Study this deal structure for your own future exit

listings.title: Learn Programming Academy - Content
listings.description: Programming education platform sold for $1.4M. Australia to US buyer. 186 days to close.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - education content is buildable
analysis.reasoning: EdTech exits are happening. Programming education has massive TAM. The longer close time (186 days vs 69) suggests more complexity or negotiation. Shows content businesses can still command good prices.
analysis.opportunity: Education + content + community is a winning formula. Programming is evergreen.

listings.title: Real Time Google Ads SaaS
listings.description: SaaS tool for real-time Google Ads management. UK-based, sold to UK buyer for $1.3M in 250 days.

analysis.uspCopyable: Low - Google Ads integrations are complex
analysis.reasoning: Marketing technology sells. Google Ads tools have built-in demand. UK domestic deal avoided cross-border complexity. 250 days is longer - likely due diligence on integrations and API dependencies.
analysis.opportunity: MarTech with platform integrations commands premiums. API relationships are moats.

listings.title: AI Voiceover SaaS Platform
listings.description: AI-powered voiceover generation platform. Text-to-speech SaaS for content creators and marketers.

analysis.uspCopyable: High - AI voice tools are commoditizing
analysis.reasoning: $3K MRR is small but validates the idea. AI voiceover is hot but also crowded (ElevenLabs, etc.). The question is differentiation - why would someone use this over the big players? Could be price, niche, or specific features.
analysis.opportunity: Could niche down (e.g., AI voices for podcasters, YouTubers, specific languages)

listings.title: AI Model Comparison Platform
listings.description: Platform to chat with and compare different AI models side-by-side. Useful for developers and businesses evaluating AI tools.

analysis.uspCopyable: High - but execution matters
analysis.reasoning: AI model comparison is genuinely useful. Everyone's evaluating GPT vs Claude vs Gemini. $2K MRR is tiny but proves there's demand. Could grow fast with right positioning. Risk is someone bigger builds this as a feature.
analysis.opportunity: First-mover in AI evaluation space. Could add benchmarking, cost calculators, enterprise features.

listings.title: AI Voice-to-Notes App
listings.description: AI-powered app that converts voice recordings to structured notes. Useful for meetings, lectures, and personal note-taking.

analysis.uspCopyable: High - many competitors (Otter, Fireflies, etc.)
analysis.reasoning: Voice-to-notes is proven market. $1.5K MRR shows some traction. Competition is fierce (Otter.ai raised $50M+). Would need strong niche or feature differentiation to grow. Could be a good learning acquisition.
analysis.opportunity: Niche down: voice notes for doctors, lawyers, specific professions with compliance needs

listings.title: Webshop in Screws & Hardware (B2B)
listings.description: B2B webshop specializing in screws and related hardware items. Strong position in construction/industrial supply niche.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - requires supplier relationships and inventory management
analysis.reasoning: B2B e-commerce in boring-but-essential products. High revenue but likely needs warehouse operations. Good if you want to run a 'real' business, not a lifestyle play.
analysis.opportunity: Consolidation play - acquire and roll up similar niche B2B webshops

listings.title: SaaS Platform & IoT Systems Integrator
listings.description: Leading IoT innovator for 20+ years. Offers WMS, Asset Management, and Field Services via proprietary SaaS platform using RFID, GPS, barcode, UWB, LoRa, WIFI, and Bluetooth technologies.

analysis.uspCopyable: Very Low - 20 years of relationships and trust
analysis.reasoning: This is a phenomenal business: 95% recurring, 55% EBITDA margin, 4 employees. BUT it's built on 20 years of enterprise relationships. You can't copy this - you'd have to buy it. If you have €3-5M, this is a cash cow.
analysis.opportunity: Buy and hold for cash flow. Don't try to replicate.

listings.title: Health & Wellness Brand
listings.description: Established brand in health and wellness products with strong platform presence. Location-independent operations.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - brand building takes time but model is replicable
analysis.reasoning: Health & wellness is a strong category with good margins. If they own the brand (not just reselling), this has real value. Location-independent is a plus. Need to verify if it's D2C brand or just a reseller.
analysis.opportunity: If it's a real brand with repeat customers, could be a solid foundation to expand product line

listings.title: Webshop Charging Stations (EV)
listings.description: Fast-growing webshop in EV charging stations (A-brands) for home and business use. Achieved strong revenue/profit in first year without Google ads. Active on NL/BE domains and Bol.com.

analysis.uspCopyable: High - the model is straightforward but timing matters
analysis.reasoning: EV adoption is accelerating. Home charging is mandatory for EV owners. This is a TIMING play - the market is growing 30%+ annually. Profitable without ads means organic/word-of-mouth is working. B2B fleet charging is even higher margin.
risks: Price pressure from manufacturers going direct
analysis.opportunity: Ride the EV wave. Expand to installation services, maintenance contracts, B2B fleet deals.

listings.title: Niche Marketplace + Forum
listings.description: Combined Dutch marketplace and forum since 2006. 140K unique monthly visitors. Fully automated with low operational costs. Asking price €550K.

analysis.uspCopyable: High concept, Low execution - community takes years to build
analysis.reasoning: 18 years of SEO authority and community trust. 140K monthly visitors is real traffic. Fully automated = true passive income. €550K asking on €90K revenue is ~6x which is fair for a passive asset. The community moat is real - you can't easily replicate 18 years of trust.
analysis.opportunity: Buy for cash flow + optionality. Could modernize (Discord, app) to re-engage community. The model is copyable - pick another niche and build over 3-5 years.

listings.title: SaaS Data Integration & Workflow Platform
listings.description: No-code SaaS platform for data integration and workflow management. Outperforms Dell Boomi, Workato, and Power Automate according to seller. Has AI application for Dutch government being rolled out nationally.

analysis.uspCopyable: Low - significant tech investment already made
analysis.reasoning: The government contract is interesting but government sales cycles are brutal (18+ months). The 'outperforms Boomi/Workato' claim needs verification. If true, could be a sleeper. If not, it's a niche tool with limited growth.
analysis.opportunity: If the tech is real, this could be acquired by a larger player. Government reference is valuable.

listings.title: Smart Home IoT Brand
listings.description: Consumer IoT startup with D2C webshop, marketplace presence, and retail distribution. Large mailing list. Seeking acquisition or investment partner for growth.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - brand building is work but model is clear
analysis.reasoning: Smart home is hot. If they own the brand and product design (even if manufactured in China), there's real value here. D2C + marketplaces + retail is good diversification. Large mailing list is an asset.
analysis.opportunity: Could be expanded with more products under the brand. Smart home ecosystem play.

listings.title: Contact Lenses E-commerce
listings.description: Specialized e-commerce business in contact lenses and related optical products. Built-in recurring revenue model.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - but competing with Lensway, Vision Direct, etc.
analysis.reasoning: Contact lenses are a subscription business in disguise. People need them monthly. €200K is small but could be a foundation. The question is why it hasn't grown more - is it operational limits or market saturation?
analysis.opportunity: Convert to subscription model if not already. Add eye care products. Small but potentially high-LTV customers.

listings.title: Web Agency (€150K+ Recurring)
listings.description: Web agency building websites, webshops, and custom software. Offers smart tools, dashboards, and integrations. €150K+ in recurring annual revenue from maintenance/hosting contracts.

analysis.uspCopyable: Medium - recurring model is replicable
analysis.reasoning: The recurring angle changes things. If it's truly €150K recurring from hosting/maintenance with minimal work, this is more like a micro-SaaS than an agency. Need to verify actual work required to maintain.
analysis.opportunity: If the recurring is truly passive (just hosting), this is a cash-flow asset. Stack multiple similar acquisitions.
